title: UK ETS aviation annual compliance deadlines QA controls

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for aviation: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: Monitoring starts on 1 January for the scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Bind monitoring to the correct scheme year.

facts.source_fact: Where required, a virtual site-visit application is due by 28 February following the scheme year.
Entitled aviation free allowances are received by 28 February for the current scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer entitlement from the date alone.

facts.source_fact: The verified annual emissions report is due by 31 March for the previous scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Keep reporting year and deadline aligned.

facts.source_fact: Allowances equal to aviation emissions must be surrendered by 30 April.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve surrender deadline and emissions basis.

facts.source_fact: An applicable improvement report is due by 30 June.
facts.expected_handling: Apply only when an improvement-report trigger exists.

facts.source_fact: Operators are advised to consider appointing a verifier in July where verification is required.
facts.expected_handling: Treat July as preparation guidance, not a statutory submission deadline.

facts.source_fact: Simplified reporters are advised to request Eurocontrol draft data in October.
facts.expected_handling: Keep recommendation distinct from mandatory deadline.

facts.source_fact: Non-significant EMP changes must be notified by 31 December in the relevant year.
Monitoring for the scheme year completes on 31 December.
facts.expected_handling: Close data period at scheme-year end.

guard_patterns.handling: Keep current and previous scheme years distinct.
Apply conditional deadlines only when triggered.
Keep allowance surrender distinct from reporting.
Do not invent emissions or allowances.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
